newsitem.title: USA: Freddie Mac to redeem $20 mln in debentures.
newsitem.headline: Freddie Mac to redeem $20 mln in debentures.

text.p: Freddie Mac said Tuesday that on March 11 it will redeem the entire $20 million principal amount of its 7.05 percent fixed-rate debentures due September 10, 1999.
The debentures have cusip number 3134A07P1. They will be redeemed at a price equal to 100 percent of the principal amount, Freddie Mac said.
Payment of principal plus interest accrued to the redemption date will be made to shareholders of record as of the close of business on March 10, 1997, it said.
Freddie Mac is a corporation chartered by Congress that buys mortgages from lenders and packages them into securities for investors.
